MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'TK-102'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'P-101A'})
RETURN EXISTS { (a)-[:line_to*1..]->(b) } AS reachable, a.tag AS source, b.tag AS destination

MATCH (source:PlantItem {tag: 'TK-102'}),
      (target:PlantItem)
WHERE target.unit_id = '1'
  AND (target:Equipment OR target:Valve)
  AND EXISTS { (source)-[:line_to*1..]->(target) }
RETURN DISTINCT target.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag
